editorial.summary: A 3:48 visually dependent spray-paint demonstration in Palo Alto. The speaker introduces black Ultra-Flat Krylon, calls it his favorite color and smell, demonstrates smooth can motion versus drips, sketches a freeway/tree/building scene, argues beginners should learn the stock cap supplied with the can, then explains how graffiti magazines and peers introduced fat caps. Stock/fat marks and a face/skull drawing are compared onscreen. The broad Life Lessons title does not describe the useful retrieval object, so the record uses can control, stock cap and fat cap. Krylon, Palo Alto and graffiti-artist caption damage is repaired; music/montage, a mask, duplicate caption and visual-only actions remain. Backwards is preserved as spoken rather than reinterpreted, and the final noun remains unclear. The archive does not invent missing drawing steps, aerosol inhalation/PPE/ventilation guidance, legality, surface compatibility, exact distance/angle/pressure or a named voice.
